name: astra-advisor
description: Community modification of DannyMac180/astra-advisor with GPT-6 Astra or GPT-5.6 Sol as the primary model.

interface.shortDescription: Use GPT-6 Astra or GPT-5.6 Sol to plan, route, verify, and review work dynamically.
interface.longDescription: Community modification of Daniel McAteer's Astra Advisor. It supports GPT-6 Astra or GPT-5.6 Sol as the primary model at the effort selected by the user. The selected parent can combine useful work with bounded permitted Codex workers chosen from a portable roster and live tool metadata.
interface.developerName: Daniel McAteer; Sol modification by chaosmorale
defaultPrompt: Use $astra-advisor:orchestration to plan, build, verify, and review this work.
Choose dynamic subagents only when bounded independent work improves delivery.
